commonQuestions.title: Common Questions
commonQuestions.subtitle: Quick answers to frequently asked questions.

q1.question: How does the AI generation work?
q1.answer: Our AI engine analyzes your design ideas and references to generate high-fidelity UI components and screens. You describe what you need in natural language, and the AI produces editable designs that you can refine and export.

q2.question: Can I export my designs?
q2.answer: Yes. You can export your designs in common formats and integrate with your design and development workflow.

q3.question: What pricing plans do you offer?
q3.answer: We offer flexible plans for individuals and teams. Check our Pricing page for the latest options and features.

q4.question: Is there a limit to generations?
q4.answer: Generation limits depend on your plan. Details are available on the Pricing page and in your account settings.

q5.question: Do you have Enterprise setup?
q5.answer: Yes. We provide Enterprise setup with custom terms, SSO, and dedicated support. Contact us to discuss your requirements.
